text:
anna_cs: quick heads-up — Nimbus onboarding is seeing a pattern: short-lived ephemeral tokens -> 401s -> client immediate retries -> our preflight/proxy returns 429s. Customer reports this on their staging and a small prod ramp :worried:
kevin_se: thanks. do we have sdk/version and a sample request flow? sounds like token TTL + fanout. any client-side reuse?
mike_sdk: what did they set for ephemeral TTL? our browser/sdk default is to reuse a token across concurrent requests for the same page/session, but if their auth proxy issues new tokens too quickly that can still fan out.
alice_nimbus: fyi we're on browser-sdk@0.9.2 + a tiny auth proxy that mints tokens for each worker. TTL we currently set to 3s to be conservative. sample sequence from their logs:
```
# simplified
12:01:00 GET /v1/chat -> 401 (token expired)
12:01:00 client requests new token from auth-proxy
12:01:00 client retries -> 401/422 race -> refresh again -> then many concurrent retries
12:01:01 proxy responds 429 (preflight rate limit)
```

alice_nimbus: they also run 8 workers per browser tab, so if one token expires they all request new tokens at the same time.
kevin_se: yep that explains it. two levers: (1) increase token TTL slightly so concurrent workers can reuse, (2) add client-side de-dup/splay so only one refresh happens per session. short-term, increase TTL to 8-12s.
mike_sdk: for immediate mitigation we recommend a small client change: single-flight refresh + jittered backoff for retries. pseudocode we send to customers: 
```
let refreshInProgress = null;
async function getToken() {
  if (cachedToken && notExpired(cachedToken)) return cachedToken;
  if (!refreshInProgress) refreshInProgress = fetchNewToken().finally(() => refreshInProgress = null);
  return await refreshInProgress;
}
// add jitter when retrying requests: backoff = base * (1 + rand())
```

julia_onboard: I'll make a short runbook we can send to Nimbus: include SDK patch (single-flight refresh), suggested TTL bump to 10s, and server-side small grace window on the token issuer (slop of ~2s). also recommend connection pooling so workers share connections.
anna_cs: (typo) anna_cs: thanks — can ops confirm we didn't hit a platform-wide surge?
ops-bot: deploy-bot reports: no global rate surge in that window. 429s localized to tenant proxy patterns.
kevin_se: follow-ups: ask Nimbus to try TTL=10s + upgrade sdk to 0.9.3-beta which has the single-flight fix. if they can't change token TTL, client splay is mandatory.
alice_nimbus: trying TTL=10s on staging now, will report back in ~30m. adding the SDK patch this afternoon.
julia_onboard: created runbook + checklist and linked: `https://redwood.internal/runbooks/preflight-fanout.md` (internal). I'll also set a monitoring alert on tenant-level 429 spikes.
ops-bot: ticket CS-4821 created for tracking (priority: P2).
anna_cs: great. short sync in 30m if staging shows improvement. :thumbsup:
kevin_se: if staging improves, we can roll recommendation to prod onboarding and include note in onboarding checklist (add token TTL >= 8s or single-flight refresh).
mike_sdk: will prepare a tiny patch and PR link once test passes.
alice_nimbus: staging looks better after TTL bump — 401s gone and no 429 ripple. thanks all!
anna_cs: closing note: mitigation confirmed. schedule follow-up with Nimbus in 2 days to ensure rollout and to review renewal checklist (they flagged time-to-value risk if docs stay unclear).
